  "patch": "--- a/SKILL.md

@@
 8. **Only choose admissible actions**: Always pick an action from the admissible action list. Do not invent actions.
 
 ---
 
+## Locate and Search Discipline
+
+During the locate phase of a pick-and-place or examine task, use your last two
+observations and actions as working memory.
+
+- When the current location does not hold the required object, do not move next to a
+  location that appears in that recent history as already examined without the
+  required object; prefer an admissible location that is not present in that history.
+- Open a closed container at the current location before leaving it (when an `open`
+  action for it is admissible), and check its contents immediately rather than
+  planning to return to it later.
+- When several similar locations are available, continue through them in a
+  consistent order (e.g., ascending index) and prefer the next similar location not
+  present in your recent history before switching to a different kind of location.
+  Do not bounce back to a similar location that your recent history shows was just
+  checked, so the same surfaces are not swept again.
+- Do not change the target object or stop the search merely because several locations
+  were empty; continue until the required object is in inventory, then leave the
+  search phase.
+
+---
+
+## Examine Tasks: Using the Desklamp
+
+In examine / "look at X under the desklamp" tasks, once the target object is in
+inventory, the remaining objective is to activate a desklamp while holding it.
+
+- If a desklamp is present at your current location, use it immediately without any
+  further navigation.
+- If not, do not remain at or return to a location that your last two observations and
+  actions show was already checked without a desklamp; choose an admissible location
+  not present in that recent history and use the first desklamp that appears in the
+  current observation, avoiding repeated movement between the same locations when the
+  lamp is not co-located.
+
+---
+
 ## Common Mistakes to Avoid
",
  "reason": "Added two new sections implementing the effective Updates: a 'Locate and Search Discipline' section covering u1 (recent-history-based avoidance of re-examined locations, opening and checking closed containers before leaving, consistent similar-location ordering, and not changing the target or aborting the search on empty locations), and an 'Examine Tasks: Using the Desklamp' section covering u2 (using a co-located desklamp immediately and avoiding returning to already-checked locations without a lamp). Existing General Principles and Common Mistakes guidance was left intact because it does not conflict and remains valid."
